info.title: WineTrail API
info.description: REST API for the WineTrail personal wine diary application

tags.name: Device Tokens
tags.description: FCM device token management for push notifications

tags.name: Map
tags.description: Geographic map data for wine journey visualization

get.summary: Get a specific tasting by ID

delete.summary: Delete a tasting and its photos

post.summary: Upload a photo to a tasting
post.description: Uploads an image (JPEG, PNG, or HEIC) to the specified tasting. Maximum file size is 10MB and maximum 5 photos per tasting.

file.description: Photo file (JPEG, PNG, or HEIC, max 10MB)

post.description: Registers a device token for push notifications. If the token already exists, updates its last_used_at timestamp.

get.summary: Search wines across user's wines, local DB, and external providers
Get the user's wines with tasting stats
Get the current user's tasting stats for a specific wine
List all tastings for a specific wine
Get map data with regions explored and drinking locations

delete.description: Deletes a photo from object storage and removes the database record. Only the tasting owner can delete.
Removes a device token. Idempotent: returns 204 even if the token does not exist.

UpdateTastingRequest.description: Request to update an existing tasting. All fields are optional

vintage.description: Vintage year of the wine tasted

url.description: Presigned URL to access the photo

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the photo was uploaded

TastingDto.description: A wine tasting entry with all details

vintage.description: Vintage year of the wine tasted

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tasting was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the tasting was last updated

CreateWineRequest.description: Request to create a user-defined wine

CreateTastingRequest.description: Request to create a new tasting. Provide either wineId or (externalSource + externalId)

wineId.description: ID of an existing wine in the local database

externalId.description: External wine ID from the provider

tastingDate.description: Date of the tasting (defaults to today)

vintage.description: Vintage year of the wine tasted

url.description: Presigned URL for accessing the photo

displayOrder.description: Display order assigned to this photo

DeviceTokenRequest.description: Request to register a device token for push notifications

wineId.description: Local wine ID (null for wines not yet in the local database)

UserWineStats.description: User's tasting statistics for a wine, including wine details

timesDrunk.description: Number of times the user has tasted this wine

lastTasted.description: Date of the most recent tasting

ActivityPoint.description: Activity data point representing tastings in a calendar week

weekStart.description: Start date of the ISO 8601 week (Monday)

count.description: Number of tastings during this week

CountryCount.description: A country with its tasting count

count.description: Number of tastings from this country

PriceStats.description: Price statistics across tastings that have a price recorded

totalSpent.description: Total amount spent across all tastings with a price

RegionCount.description: A wine region with its tasting count

count.description: Number of tastings from this region

UserStats.description: Personal wine statistics for the user's dashboard

topRegions.description: Top 10 regions ranked by tasting count

topCountries.description: Top 10 countries ranked by tasting count

averageRating.description: Average rating across all tastings, rounded to 1 decimal

activityTimeline.description: Activity timeline with tastings per ISO 8601 week

priceStats.description: Price statistics across tastings that have a price recorded

LocationPin.description: Map pin for a tasting location

tastingCount.description: Number of tastings at this location

MapData.description: Map data for the user's wine journey

drinkingLocations.description: Pins for locations where the user had tastings
